{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded = sales[refunded_mask]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}")

# Filter out rows with missing age (customer_age == -1)
valid_age_mask = sales['customer_age'] != -1
valid_age_data = sales[valid_age_mask]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean customer age (valid data only): {mean_age}")

# Final clean dataset for age computation
final_data = valid_age_data
